items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I hit it right off, and Bea, boy, she is a treasure. She is a treasure. She really is.

ctx.x: I know he likes your playing a lot. He was talking – we’ve been talking about you.
He and I hit it right off, and Bea, boy, she is a treasure. She is a treasure. She really is.
She’s crazy. They’ve been together for a long time.
